entities.name: Amy（ESG 推廣專員）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D young Taiwanese office woman; wavy chin-length brown bob with side-swept bangs, large expressive green eyes, light freckles; wearing a heather-grey fitted blazer with rolled/cuffed sleeves, slim tailored trousers, cream open-collar silk blouse, dark-brown low pumps; highly animated expressions ranging from anxious overload to radiant epiphany, energetic Vlogger persona.
entities.notes: 全劇女主角，從苦惱的政策執行者轉變為充滿活力的 ESG 尋寶獵人。

entities.name: George（資深企業永續顧問）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D older male character; swept-back silver-grey hair; thick grey eyebrows; hazel eyes; a prominent nose; visible facial lines; short white moustache and beard stubble; dark brown square-framed glasses; textured brown buttoned waistcoat; cream collared shirt with rolled sleeves; dark brown tie; dark brown trousers; brown lace-up shoes; wristwatch on his left wrist.
entities.notes: Amy 的良師益友，在咖啡館與公園以健身教練等通俗比喻指引 ESG 核心邏輯。

entities.name: 主管（大成科技行政協理）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D middle-aged East-Asian corporate manager; disheveled short black thinning hair, worried furrowed brows, prominent round nose, faint stubble; wearing a pale-blue dress shirt with rolled-up sleeves, loosened diagonal-striped brown silk tie, dark brown trousers, polished belt; hyper-expressive, comedic stress posture, easily excitable.
entities.notes: 面臨增資案卡關的咆哮主管，典型業績導向但講求情理的管理階層。

entities.name: Mr. Harrison（倫敦跨國基金資深合夥人）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D older British senior executive; impeccably slicked-back platinum-silver hair, sharp bushy dark grey brows, aristocratic hawkish nose, piercing steel-blue eyes with disciplined stern gaze; wearing an immaculate bespoke navy pinstripe three-piece suit, crisp white stiff-collar shirt, silk regimental tie; commanding aristocratic presence.
entities.notes: 第一幕冷酷否決『Risk is not attractive』，第五幕被真實數據與全員承諾打動批准投資。

entities.name: Sandy（海外投資機構審查分析師）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D young professional woman analyst; brunette hair neatly gathered into a professional low chignon with side-parted fringe, smart black modern rectangular glasses, keen blue-grey eyes; fitted black sharp pantsuit, silk off-white blouse, blue institutional lanyard with magnetic security badge, modest silver stud earrings; crisp and articulate.
entities.notes: 倫敦會議室負責向哈里森先生報告大成科技案件的專業審查員。

entities.name: 小陳（研發部研發工程師）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D young male material engineer; tousled black hair with slightly messy bangs, black wire-rimmed glasses, timid earnest smile; wearing a graphite work vest with multiple pen pockets over a moss-green long-sleeve casual shirt, khaki cargo pants, durable work sneakers; passionate about sustainable polymers but previously overlooked.
entities.notes: 研發出環保寶特瓶毛毯的幕後功臣，在第四幕被 Amy 重新發掘價值。

entities.name: 王大哥（採購部資深主管 / 算盤俠）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D seasoned male procurement officer in his late 40s; receding hairline with combed-back black hair, round wire-rim reading glasses perched low on his nose, calculating furrowed brow that relaxes into a broad grin; wearing an off-white button-down shirt with buttoned chest pocket full of receipts and pens, dark-brown knit sweater vest, beige slacks; meticulous and cost-conscious.
entities.notes: 錙銖必較的採購主管，透過綠色碳成本小抄覺醒，為公司避開碳稅地雷。

entities.name: Linda（IT 部資深軟體工程師）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D young woman developer; straight jet-black hair tied in a practical ponytail, purple-tinted stylish acetate glasses, pale complexion from monitor glow, cool confident smirk; wearing an oversized dark-violet hoodie with stylized digital icons, slim dark jeans, bright canvas sneakers, lanyard with multiple USB sticks; pragmatic and highly efficient.
entities.notes: 為了偷懶寫出自動抓取供應商碳排數據爬蟲的神人，雙軸轉型的實踐者。

entities.name: 標哥（廠務部資深領班 / 黃金獵人）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D burly veteran plant foreman; weathered tanned skin, friendly crinkly eyes, thick bristly mustache, warm gap-toothed chuckle; wearing a high-visibility neon yellow-orange safety vest over heavy-duty navy twill work overalls, yellow protective hardhat with company logo, heavy steel-toed work boots; hearty, dependable, proud of factory safety.
entities.notes: 廠務現場領班，把廢棄物邊角料分類變黃金，並實現工安意外連續半年歸零。

entities.name: 小李（行銷部創意文案企劃）
entities.description: Pixar-style 3D energetic young male creative marketer; trendy wavy undercut hairstyle, stylish round tortoiseshell frames, expressive theatrical facial gestures; wearing a mustard-yellow oversized corduroy overshirt over a graphic white tee, rolled cuff chinos, fashion sneakers; full of wild promotional slogans, eager to learn corporate governance ethics.
entities.notes: 行銷部點子王，曾差點寫出『漂綠』誇大標語，經 Amy 導正領會 Governance 誠信真諦。

entities.name: Amy 與主管辦公室（行政辦公區）
entities.description: Contemporary Taipei corporate office; open-plan layout with light birchwood workstations, sage-green acoustic dividers, dual monitors, potted snake plants and succulents, warm overhead linear LED architectural lighting, glass-partitioned private managerial office in the background with city view.
entities.notes: 第一幕主管咆哮、第三幕Amy深夜加班頓悟，以及第五幕文化落地的核心辦公室場景。

entities.name: 新潮風格咖啡館（George 與 Amy 請益地）
entities.description: Warm wood-toned cafe; tall wood-framed glass windows with outdoor greenery visible; dark green wall sections between windows; wooden counter seating along the windows; vertical wood wall paneling with framed botanical prints and trailing greenery; wooden tables and spindle-back chairs in the seating area between the windows and service counter; wood-paneled service counter with a pale countertop and glass pastry case; espresso machine in the service area; natural daylight through the windows.
entities.notes: 第二幕解密ESG、第三幕推演行動地圖五步驟的思維殿堂。

entities.name: 研發部樣品開發室
entities.description: High-tech fabric R&D workshop and sample lab; large central cutting table piled with textile swatches, spools of recycled polymer thread, magnifying test lamps, pegboards holding drafting tools, shelves lined with raw plastic pellets and prototype blankets, blueprint posters on concrete walls.
entities.notes: 第四幕尋寶第一站，小陳存放兩年前環保毛毯的研發基地。

entities.name: 採購部辦公室（帳房）
entities.description: Busy corporate procurement office; sturdy dark wood desks stacked with supplier binders, ledger folders, dual calculation screens, filing cabinets, green banker lamps alongside fluorescent tubes, financial charts pinned to acoustic corkboards, organized paperwork atmosphere.
entities.notes: 第四幕尋寶第二站，王大哥按計算機核算綠色採購成本的場所。

entities.name: IT 資訊技術研發中心
entities.description: Modern software engineering bay; subdued ambient blue lighting with backlit LED server racks behind soundproof glass, multi-monitor curved displays glowing with automated code streams and data visualization dashboards, cable organizers, ergonomic mesh chairs, tech gadgets and sticky notes.
entities.notes: 第四幕尋寶第三站，Linda 撰寫爬蟲系統實現雙軸轉型的科技工坊。

entities.name: 廠務車間與資源回收暫存區
entities.description: Immaculately clean and organized factory staging facility; wide concrete thoroughfare with bright yellow safety line markings, clear overhead signage for sorted scrap metals and plastics, high industrial ceiling with ventilation ducts, parked orange forklift with clear line of sight, zero clutter, model industrial safety environment.
entities.notes: 第四幕尋寶第四站，標哥將邊角料分類變黃金、工安意外歸零的硬核現場。

entities.name: 行銷企劃部創意會議室
entities.description: Vibrant design brainstorming lounge; colorful magnetic moodboards covered in poster mockups, Pantone color chips, circular collaboration table with marker pens and sketches, warm spherical pendant lights, large presentation monitor, dynamic creative agency aesthetic.
entities.notes: 第四幕尋寶第五站，小李與 Amy 探討防漂綠海報宣傳的創意空間。

entities.name: 倫敦投資審查會議室與幻想電視棚
entities.description: Dual visual space: Ultra-luxurious glass boardroom overlooking foggy London skyline with walnut conference table and executive leather seating; seamlessly transitioning in fantasy cuts into glossy vibrant studio lighting with presentation screens.
entities.notes: 第一幕投資審查被拒與第五幕大逆轉核准的重要殿堂。

entities.name: 回收寶特瓶環保毛毯
entities.description: Plush, high-density fleece blanket woven from recycled PET yarns; subtle textured weave in muted sage-grey and eco-green, elegant hemmed border, featuring a small woven minimalist leaf logo patch; soft, premium textile tactile feel.
entities.notes: 第四幕研發部核心成果，象徵環境面 E 的實務突破。

entities.name: 壓縮回收透明寶特瓶
entities.description: Clean, compacted transparent PET plastic water bottle with cyan tinted plastic cap, embossed recycling triangle logo with number 1, pristine clean surface showing raw material potential.
entities.notes: Amy 在研發部 Vlog 開場展示的原始原料。

entities.name: 採購部專用財務計算機
entities.description: Chunky desktop financial calculator with large angled LCD display showing glowing digital numbers, dual solar cell strip, high-contrast dark keys with distinct orange clear button, durable matte grey casing.
entities.notes: 王大哥核算綠色採購成本並發現反而省下 10% 的關鍵道具。

entities.name: 大成科技海外增資計畫書
entities.description: Thick corporate prospectus folder bound in matte navy cardstock, gold-foil embossed logo reading 'DACENG TECH EXPANSION & ESG ROADMAP', clean white archival inner pages with tables and financial bar graphs.
entities.notes: 貫穿第一幕與第五幕的關鍵公文。

entities.name: 血紅色「ON HOLD」印章
entities.description: Heavy industrial brass and dark wood hand stamp; base features sharp rubber lettering, leaving a stark, smeared blood-red rectangular imprint reading 'ON HOLD' with distressed institutional border.
entities.notes: 第一幕哈里森先生下達凍結投資的震撼印記。

entities.name: 翡翠綠「APPROVED」印章
entities.description: Sleek modern brass stamp leaving an authoritative, vibrant emerald-green rectangular stamp mark with double-line border reading 'APPROVED - TIER 1 SUSTAINABILITY'.
entities.notes: 第五幕終場完美覆蓋紅色印章的終極勝利標誌。

entities.name: 咖啡館陶瓷馬克杯
entities.description: Minimalist modern porcelain coffee cup and matching saucer in pure glossy white, sleek handle, filled with hot latte featuring delicate silky latte art foam; completely uniform clean white glaze without exposed terracotta or raw pottery base.
entities.notes: Amy 在第二幕與第三幕向 George 請益時端上的象徵性咖啡。

entities.name: 咖啡桌玻璃糖罐
entities.description: Clear fluted glass sugar jar with polished stainless steel dispenser lid, sparkling granulated white cane sugar visible inside, casting warm refracted highlights on wood tabletop.
entities.notes: 咖啡館桌面的環境細節道具。

entities.name: 咖啡館木質黑板菜單
entities.description: Rustic wooden framed tabletop menu stand with blackboard surface, featuring hand-chalked artisanal espresso drinks, single-origin pour-overs, and a tiny stylized leaf emblem.
entities.notes: 咖啡館背景道具。

entities.name: 吧台陶瓷杯展示架
entities.description: Sleek wall-mounted walnut wood shelving unit displaying a neat row of artisanal ceramic coffee cups and saucers in gradient earthy pastel tones (terracotta, sage, cream, charcoal).
entities.notes: 咖啡館背景構圖的層次道具。

entities.name: Amy 專用 Vlog 智慧型手機
entities.description: Slim flagship modern smartphone with matte lavender-grey titanium edges, three camera lenses with anti-reflective coating, screen displaying a glowing red recording REC indicator and front selfie camera preview.
entities.notes: Amy 貫穿第四幕走訪各部門錄製大尋寶的主武器。

entities.name: 商務旗艦橫式平板電腦
entities.description: Ultra-thin professional tablet in landscape orientation with edge-to-edge liquid retina display, showing an interactive verified ESG dashboard with dynamic line charts, emission bars, and video preview tile.
entities.notes: 海外投資會議室遞給哈里森先生審核報告與影片的高階平板。

entities.name: 直式展示數位平板
entities.description: Modern tablet in portrait orientation displaying digital ESG checklist items with interactive green toggle switches and verification badges.
entities.notes: 用於展示檢核清單與直式圖表的數位設備。

entities.name: ESG 萬靈丹金色膠囊與藥罐
entities.description: Playful, stylized glowing golden pill bottle with cream label reading 'ESG 萬靈丹' adorned with twin green leaf icons; several translucent golden capsules glowing with sparkling green particles spilled beside it; stylized comedic visual metaphor.
entities.notes: 第二幕 Amy 誤以為 ESG 是特效藥時的趣味幻想道具。

entities.name: 咖啡廳桌面雙人咖啡與糖罐套裝
entities.description: Unified tabletop coffee set on warm natural wood table: two minimalist modern porcelain coffee cups and matching saucers in pure glossy white with latte art, together with a fluted glass sugar jar with polished stainless steel lid, perfectly matched lighting and reflections.
entities.notes: 咖啡廳對話桌面標準整合道具圖，整合咖啡杯碟與糖罐，避免生圖注意力稀釋。
